sql: SELECT s.School, f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate, f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS FRPMCount FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = '66' ORDER BY f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC LIMIT 5
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    s.School, 
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate, 
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS FRPMCount
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC
LIMIT 5
```

sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T3.A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM trans AS T1 JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.date LIKE '1996%'
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN T3.A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN T3.A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
  trans AS T1
JOIN 
  account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN 
  district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE 
  T1.date LIKE '1996%'
```

sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS race_completion_percentage FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
    drivers AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN 
    races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE 
    T3.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
```
